simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֲדֹנִי־בֶזֶק (H137) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֲדֹנִי־בֶזֶק (ʼĂdônîy-Bezeq) means Adoni-Bezek ; a Canaanitish king First listed occurrence: Judg 1 5.

definitions.full: H137. Adoni -bezeq אֲדֹנִיבֶֿ֫זֶק proper name, masculine (or title) king of Canaanite city Bezek Judg 1:7 ; without Maqqeph 1:5 ; 1:6 . **Read probably קּצֶ֫דֶק׳א , see GFM 1:5 .
